newsitem.title: USA: NYPA 780 MW Fitzpatrick power plant resumes output.
newsitem.headline: NYPA 780 MW Fitzpatrick power plant resumes output.

text.p: New York Power Authority's (NYPA) 780 megawatt James A. Fitzpatrick nuclear power plant resumed electricity production early Friday following an outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, in Scriba, N.Y., was producing at 20 percent of capacity and was increasing power as of early Friday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The unit began startup on Monday from a scheduled maintenance and refueling shutdown which started Oct 26.
